description: This file defines classes and parsing logic for date/time expressions, including relative dates like '@today' and '@now', and date ranges, using the Parlot parsing library.

classes.name: BuildExpressionContext
classes.description: Holds context information for building expressions, including current UTC time, parameter, member, and type.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Abstract base class for expression nodes.

classes.name: OperatorNode
classes.description: Abstract class for nodes representing operators with build logic for comparison expressions.

classes.name: DateNode
classes.description: Represents a date comparison node with a specific DateTimeOffset.

classes.name: DateNode2
classes.description: Represents a date comparison node with a DateTime, used in parsing.

classes.name: NowNode
classes.description: Represents a relative 'now' date node, optionally with an arithmetic offset.

classes.name: TodayNode
classes.description: Represents a relative 'today' date node, optionally with an arithmetic offset.

classes.name: UnaryExpressionNode
classes.description: Represents a unary expression node wrapping an operator node.

classes.name: BinaryExpressionNode
classes.description: Represents a binary expression node with left and right operator nodes, for range expressions.

classes.name: DateTimeParser
classes.description: Static class providing a parser for date/time expressions, including relative and range expressions.

classes.name: DateTimeParseContext
classes.description: Context class for parsing date/time expressions, including culture info, clock, and timezone.

methods.name: BuildExpression
methods.description: Abstract method to build an expression from the node.

methods.name: BuildOperation
methods.description: Builds a comparison expression based on the operator.

methods.name: BuildExpression
methods.description: Builds an expression for date/time nodes.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns string representation of date/time nodes.

methods.name: BuildExpression
methods.description: Builds a lambda expression for unary and binary expression nodes.
